Among the different mini-games, there's a Hangman clone, a session of The Towers of Hanoi, a run around the city to try to find the girl's house, a maze-crawl through a ventilation system, and a Rat Race that pits you as a rat called Squad Car trying to win a race against three to five other rats. There are three difficulty levels to choose from.
All Guns Blazing

An automotive duel which takes place between two cars whizzing around a top-down viewed track. The winner is the first to either complete a set number of laps or to blast their opponent to more pieces than a warehouse full of jigsaw puzzles. Includes a course designer.
All New World of Lemmings

More lemming action this time with new skills and obstacles for them to overcome. Three islands to adventure on each featuring a different tribe of Lemmings to save. They are as follows, Classic Lemmings, Egyptian Lemmings, or the Shadow Lemmings.
All Rounder

All Rounder is a shareware cricket game for the Amiga, it can be played by two people or by one person against the computer.

This game is based on a board and dice game from the seventies which inspired the author to develop first a game for the ZX81 and later games for the VIC 20 and the BBC B.

This game features graphics and 198 players, in it the player plays a full season of 153 games where all seventeen teams play each other. It also has a summary mode of play which enables the player to skip a match and let the game work out a result.
All Valley Karate Championships

After suffering bullying at his high school, Daniel receives karate classes.
Once you have learned the movements, you decide to sign up for the valley karate tournament. As Daniel you will have to face all the members of the Cobra kai in the tournament and thus win the Valley tournament. In the Valley tournament mode, you can play two players in a classic match up. In the Free Tournament mode, you can play with your friends and face them to win the tournament, in this mode with up to 8 players.
All-Square
A Licenseware puzzle game released by Amivision in 1993, bundled with another puzzle game, by the name of Spectra.
Alliance II
An AMOS based strategy game by Mark Potter released as freeware in 1991.
Allrox
Allrox is a vertical scrolling shoot'em up in a space setting.
Almagica: Scions of a Forgotten World

Almagica: Scions Of A Forgotten World is an RTS not unlike Command & Conquer that was never ported to the platform. As Amiga was losing its commercial power, fewer and fewer games were ported to it, so the developers saw a business potential. In the end, the plan didn't work out as the game was never released. What was released however was a functional preview, letting us play this one.

Gameplay follows the principles of the standard RTS formula. You click the mouse on any subject or building and a group of buttons specific to the selection pop ups on the right. From here you can tell workers to move to a certain location, start cutting down trees for lumber (an important commodity), or build buildings (what the lumber is for). Adding the different types of buildings allows you to increase the speed of growth of your population.

The object is to build up your population and army and then wipe out the other tribes.
Alone in the Dark

An unofficial Amiga port of the 1994 Macintosh Alone in the Dark 1.0 by Infogrames and Interplay. Explore the mansion of Derceto as Edward Carnby or Emily Hartwood, solving puzzles and surviving its creatures.

The port runs the original 68k game code with an Amiga implementation of the Macintosh services it uses. Graphics use AGA bitplanes; music and effects use Paula. The game runs through the ending and returns to the title sequence. See the coverage and limits and open work for the remaining investigations.
Alpha Fight
Alpha Fight is a split-screen horizontal shooter made by a demogroup.
Alpha-1

Alpha-1 is 2D side-scrolling slow-paced shoot'em up game in space, similar to R-Type. The player is pilot of Alpha-1 spacecraft, he fights against robotic-looking aliens' invasion - aliens invade Earth, and action takes place in space and aliens' lair. The player flies right forward and kill all enemies on screen. Alpha-1 has upgradeable energy cannon, the ship can shoot down enemy missiles.
Alphabet

An educational freeware game where the alphabet can be seen and experienced by a young user. It will automatically show the Alphabet by showing the letters in order or if a letter key is pressed it will display for that letter.
Alter Ego

A Platforming game game released at Retrokomp/Loadererror Retroparty 2015, it is an unofficial port of the ZX\C64 game by RetroSouls. Alter Ego is an action puzzle platformer. In this game, you control a hero and his phantom 'alter ego' that mirrors all your moves (either horizontally or vertically) from across the screen. You can switch between the hero and his alter ego a limited number of times in each level, in order to avoid enemies and reach inaccessible places. The aim of the game is to collect all purple and green boxes which can be picked up by a hero or his phantom respectively.
Altered Beast

You are a hero raised from the dead by the god Zeus to rescue his daughter Athena. With scenery inspired by Ancient Greece, you have to fight hordes of undead and demons, with a boss at the end of each level until you meet the god Neff, who holds the girl captive.

The Altered Beast title refers to your shapeshifting abilities. In this platformer, you can collect spirit balls by defeating two-headed wolves, allowing you to mutate into different beasts such as a werewolf, a dragon, a tiger, a bear and others depending on the version. Each form, tied to a level, comes with special abilities such as flight and powerful attacks, easily superseding the basic set of punches and kicks in your human form.

The game can be played in single player mode, or in same-screen multiplayer co-op mode.
Altered Destiny

One fine day P. J. Barrett, an ordinary human being from the planet Earth, goes to a repair shop to fix his TV set. When he comes back for it, he accidentally picks up a wrong one. No big deal? Quite on the contrary. When the unsuspecting Mr. Barrett returns home and turns the TV on, he is sucked into a portal! One moment later he finds himself on the strange planet of Daltere. Naturally, this planet needs a savior: the evil alien Helmar has stolen an artifact known as the Jewel of Light, thus endangering the entire galaxy. Now our unlikely hero has to overcome various obstacles and to save the world.

Altered Destiny is a puzzle-solving adventure game. The interface is very similar to the one used in Les Manley games by the same company. The navigation can be done with the mouse (point-and-click), but the game still requires text input to issue commands to the hero and to interact with the world.
Alternate Reality: The City

In this old first-person RPG, you are one of many people who have been abducted from earth by aliens and transported to an alternate dimension where you are dumped in a strange, yet familiar city. Your quest is to explore the city, and find the clues that will lead you to your captors and help you get back home.

In addition to standard first-person RPG's of that era, like skills, stats, experience points and a repertoire of shops and places to visit, the game offered moral evaluation of your character, and depending on your actions you would be good or evil, and that affected how the environment reacted to you. Encounters were not necessarily just resolved with combat, but you could also try to trick, charm or bribe opponents, and the storyline is very non-linear, for example allowing you to take a job in order to enhance a particular skill or just to pass away time. Alternate Reality: The City is the first part of an unfinished series of five planned RPG's.
Am-Tank

Am-Tank is an artillery clone for Amiga similar to Scorched Earth. Before a battle, you get to set the mountain height, air resistance and sound effects. You move your tank and the camera, set the angle and the power of your cannon, and then fire. Whoever gets the first hit wins. The game lacks computer-controlled tanks, so the game is designed for only two players.
Amanda's Alphabet Jigsaw Jumble

Amanda's Alphabet Jigsaw Jumble is an Educational game created and published by Rush Software in Oceania. Un-jumble the pictures to see the word that corresponds to the letter you chose. Learn while you play!
Amastermind

This is a shareware mastermind-type game in which the player must work out a hidden combination of colors based on clues given by the game. The shareware game was free to distribute, but users would need to pay in order to gain access to all features, updates and to remove nags. The game was later published in Now That's What I Call Games in 1993 for CD enabled Amiga computers by Multi Media Machine Ltd.
Amazed
Amazed is a horizontally scrolling shooter game, developed by ECP and published by Electronic Arts, which was released in Europe and Australia in 1991.
Ambassador: Fruitmachine
Ambassador is a slot machine simulator that the developer John Ingham (Transvamp) updated for years, sometimes renaming the game in the process while not changing anything fundamental in it.
Amber

Nearly the same as 'Risk'. Simple graphics but close to the board game which I liked very much. Benefit: You are able to change more settings (compared to Risk) and therewith you have the possibility to alter the game. Handling is not as easy as at Risk. Altogether playing is fun.
Ambermoon

Ambermoon is the second game in Thalion's never-finished Amber trilogy that was started out by Amberstar. The sequel is set more than half a century after the first game, the world of Lyramion just starting to recover from the destruction caused by the collapse of the red moon. The original protagonist is an old, dying man as the game starts out. He summons his grandchild and tells him about a vision he had, of an old friend who supposedly died more than forty years ago and warned him of a great evil rising again. He sends the youth on a quest to seek that old friend and find out what is behind that vision.

Concerning gameplay, Ambermoon is similar to its predecessor. The player initially controls only the main character, having the choice between a male and a female protagonist with several portraits each, but otherwise unable to customize them at that point.
Ambermoon Advanced

Ambermoon Advanced is an extension of Ambermoon. It adds content like new places, quests, monsters, NPCs and items.Moreover it changes a few aspects of the game to balance it, add a bit more challenge or make some aspects or characters more valuable. Version 1.3x contains the first 3 episodes: Mysteries of the sea, Elemental creatures, The green jewel
Ambermoon Arcade

There you are, on a dusty road in the middle of the Hoimon desert and your enemies are right at your heels. It has been two days since you escaped from the captivity of the orcs and their allies. Your destination is the city of Spannenberg. You will be safe there and catch your breath. It sis still a long way to Newlake, but soon you will be reunited with your friends. ...and then the orc's barbaric slavery will be put to an end.
Amberstar

A thousand years ago, a young Black Magician named Tar valiantly fought the demon lord Thornahuun, who was revealed to be his own father. However, Thornahuun managed to possess his son's soul and corrupt it. Tar declared himself Lord Tarbos and brought terror to the land of Lyramion, before being locked away in a secure prison on the world's red moon. Now, a sorcerer named Marmion is trying to release him, with the intention of spreading horror through the land. A lone adventurer from the town of Twinlake must gather thirteen pieces of a powerful artifact known as Amberstar to prevent that from happening.

Amberstar is a role-playing game which uses a top-down view for overworld travel and most indoor locations, and switches to a first-person pseudo-3D perspective when exploring cities and dungeons. Initially the player creates a single protagonist with randomly assigned attributes and no class designation.
Amega Race

In the year 2013, The Amegan system developed a method of training its warriors to protect their star colonies. Over the city of Komar, android-controlled fighters raced to engage and destroy these Amegan warriors. The Amegan method is so successful it commands fear and respect from all throughout the galaxies. The method is codenamed Amega Race.

Amega Race is a remake of an 1981 arcade game, Omega Race. You control a small triangle, i.e. your spaceship. The ship can turn, move forward with thrusters and fire "Droid" ships that attack you. Once the ship is moving, it can only be slowed by turning the nose in the opposite direction and using the thrusters.

There is no end to this game. Rather, it is a game in which you try to get the highest score, or complete the highest number of levels.
Amegas

Amegas is a Breakout variant which conforms to, and expands on the play mechanics of the established Arkanoid canon. 

The basic lay remains to control a bat which slides back and forth at the bottom of the screen. Stacks of coloured bricks are arranged in patterns above. The object is being to bounce a ball to hit the bricks to make them disappear. Some bricks’ require multiple hits to destroy - visually indicated by dots shown on the face. Some special bricks are distinguished from others by unique icons, e.g. one with a’ skull’ will result in a loss of life if hit by the ball, or one with an ‘x’ mark will cause new bricks to spawn & spread. 

At times bricks will yield colour-coded pickups which topple down and may be caught, resulting in a special power-up feature being given.
American Chainik In Russia
Based on 1998 "Homer Simpson in Russia" for ZX-Spectrum, the adventure game is a top down view adventure game where you need to find the object to help you solve the problems.
American Football Coach

A sports management game seemingly, only ever sold via mail order direct from the developer/publisher Composer Software. In it you play in a worldwide based on the real World League of American Football that was active in 1991 and 1992. Manage London against heavy hitters like the Sacramento Surge as they grind the grid-iron in search of a ten yard advance or a touchdown. Trade, set contracts and get the best players to win a true world championship and the AMOSBowl. The game was created in AMOS and sold commercially via mail order and through Shareware.
American Gladiators

American Gladiators is licensed from the popular TV show of the same name. It features a series of events testing players' strength, speed and skill against a trained team of ten 'Gladiators', five male and five female. The female characters are Ice, Gold, Lace, Blaze and Zap, most of them know by their bodybuilding achievements. Main male characters are Turbo, Nitro (he featured several US National TV commercials), Gemini, Thunder and Laser (Mr. Montana on 1986).

In total there are seven events, all viewed from third-person views. The final one is the Eliminator assault course., in which you compete directly against an opponent.
American History Adventure

American History Adventure is a text-based trivia game related to American history for multiple systems.

The player takes on the role of a roving time-travelling reporter who must interview various important people from North American history. Starting with Leif Erikson and his visit to North America, the player must answer multiple choice questions, where the follow up question is always related to the previous answer whether right or wrong. The player receives 100 points for a correct answer and 0 points for a wrong answer. The player can ask for a hint, but then the correct answer is only worth 50 points. Trivia questions move forward chronologically through American history. The player receives a final score at the end of their adventure.

Despite what the title screen says, the game was released in 1986 on the Amiga.
American Poker

American Poker is an enhanced conversion of a classic gambling coin-op machine poker game. The game features two modes: gambling and fun. Gambling mode is a standard poker game against computer. The player makes a bet, chooses the cards and gets rewarded for collecting one of the winning layouts. After winning the game the player participates in a game of chance, guessing the hidden cards. Fun mode is expanded by an additional option - the possibility of buying 54 pieces of a picture of a naked woman. The price of one piece depends on the chosen difficulty level.

The game features digitized speech in Polish and English languages.
American Tag-Team Wrestling

Released at a budget price around the peak of the WWF's original popularity, the twist in this wrestling game is the tag-team nature of competition. Each player selects two wrestlers from those on offer, and when the one in the ring is weakened he can go to the edge of the ring and tag his team-mate, who then enters the ring and allows the other to recover.

You can either play individual matches (for one or two players) or a full tournament, with three rounds of variable length. There is no joystick-waggling in the control system, with a variety of kicks, throws and punches on offer using simple joystick motions. Once the players are close together they grapple - this gives you a chance to lift and then piledrive your opponent.
Ami Blood

A demo game created using AMOS and Backbone by Johnny Acevedo Martin and MsMadLemon for Amiten Software in 2018. It is a single player platformer where you jump on the rats, and other denizens of the darkness, collect the crosses and stay out of the spike pits. The goal is to find the exit and leave this place.
Ami Dasher I

An Emerald Mines\Boulderdash style game created with the Emerald Mine Editor by The Bullfrog and released by the Emerald Mines Club of Australia in 1992. This version pulls from the C64 game of the same name and supports only one player. Otherwise it appears to follow normal Emerald Mines rules, collect the gems and avoid being crushed or caught by baddies.
Ami H.E.R.O.

A game inspired by Activision's game H.E.R.O. from Atari 2600/XL, C64 and Collecovision.

There is trouble in the mines! Volcanic activity has trapped numerous miners, and it is your job to save them. As Roderick Hero, you need to make your way through the dangerous mine shaft avoiding the dangerous creatures and lava, and find out where the miners are located before you run out of energy. To help on your mission, Roderick Hero has several useful types of equipment. A prop pack will allow you to hover and fly around the mine shaft and (hopefully) avoid the many dangers within. 

Your helmet features a short-range microlaser beam which can be used to destroy the bats, spiders, snakes, and other creatures you'll encounter in the mines. From time to time, your path through the mine may be blocked by stone or lava walls. You begin each mission with six sticks of dynamite, which can be used to destroy these obstacles (be careful you don't blow yourself up, though!).
Ami Invaders
A nice looking space invaders for the Amiga that gives you the feel of the arcade machine experience.
Ami Mind

Ami Mind is a take on classic code-breaking game MasterMind. 

The computer sets the pattern and the player tries to guess the pattern, in both order and color, within ten turns. Each guess is made by placing a row of code pegs on the decoding board. Once placed, the computer provides feedback by placing from zero to four key pegs in the small holes of the row with the guess. A green key peg is placed for each code peg from the guess which is correct in both color and position. A white key peg indicates the existence of a correct color code peg placed in the wrong position.

Released in the following:

[1] Intersoft 1213
[2] Released 1993-03-03 on Amiga Fantastic Software issue 3 March/April.
Ami Puzzle

Ami Puzzle is a simple tile puzzle game for kids. The player may choose one of three difficulty levels, consisting of 15, 30 or 60 puzzles. The game features 20 pictures all together. Help button lets the player to check the original picture at any time.
Ami Robbo 2

Based on the original Port from Atari XLXE this sequel to the Polish game by Tukinem is a fiendishly fun puzzle game was a submission the the AmiGameJam 2024 and now being published with polish and updates by K&A+ as a two floppy set in a hard box with manual and some fun gifts. Avoid baddies, magnets and other robotic hazards to get to the spaceship that will get you farther in your quest.
AMI-gotchi
An Amiga based freeware Tamagotchi game where you must care and feed your sprite to keep it happy!
Ami-Tower
This is a port of Icy Tower written in Blitz Basic 2 for Amiga.
AmiBird
A FlappyBird clone for the Amiga 1200 computer, made by Dean Hand and released in 2017.
AmiBlock

A game modeled on Wood Block Puzzle.
Minimal requirements: Amiga 500.
Amibox

AmiBOX is a logic game where we have to connect all elements together in one network. On each board is one transmitter and several receivers which we have to connect to it. Each element can be rotated in two direction, left and right. To complete the level we have to connect all receivers with the transmitter using all the elements on the screen. Each board has a time limit and after it the game ends.
AmiBrixx
AmiBrixx is a puzzle-game for the amiga computer. It is a port of the PC-game Joemine (Copyright Joe Koperski).
Amico8

Amico8 is a PICO-8 fantasy console emulator for Amiga computers with a 68020 or better processor. It loads and runs PICO-8 cartridges in both text (.p8) and image (.p8.png) format directly from the Amiga file system.
Amicube
This is Rubik's cube for classic PAL Amiga, a later version had NTSC support. Written in Amos Professional 2.0, game download contains source code.
Amidar

Amidar is a 1982 arcade game by Konami that is now converted for the Amiga 500. This is an attempted 1:1 port for Amiga 500, it requires 1MB memory
 

FEATURES:
- original visual & sounds
- faithful enemy behaviour & speed & increasing difficulty
- 50 frames per second (PAL) even on a 68000 A500
- all levels & bonus levels
- original intro
- joystick controlled (port 1) or keyboard controls (arrows + space)
- can run directly from shell or from whdload (fast machines/complex configurations)
 

CONTROLS:
- joystick directions/arrows: move player
- space/fire button: start game
- P/second button: pause
- F10 (or quitkey): quit (and save scores)
 

HOW TO PLAY:
- avoid enemies
- eat all dots (odd levels) to complete level
- paint all zones (even levels) to complete level.
AmiDonkey

In this Game and Watch style game by Carlos Peris you must get the key, avoid the nasties and make your way to the top of the level safely. It is based on the gameplay of Game & Watch: Donkey Kong II.
Amiga 15 Puzzle

Amiga 15 Puzzle is a retro adaptation of the classic 15 Puzzle, bringing this simple but addictive puzzle game to the Amiga 500.The objective is simple: move the numbered tiles around the board and arrange them in the correct order, using the single empty space to slide the pieces into position.
Amiga 4096
The Amiga version of 4096 is essentially a clone of the original 2048 game on mobile devices but twice as difficult! Created by Coagulus n 2014.

Amiga Backgammon

A single player, freeware implementation of Backgammon created by David Addison and John Everett using AmigaBASIC. You will play the light pieces and move clockwise from the upper left. To move a piece, click on the piece to be moved and the destination point. To bear off, use the bar on the left as the destination. If you do not have a valid move, click on the dice.
Amiga Biznes 2

AmigaBiznes is a game based on Eurobusiness (polish Monopoly variant). Players move clockwise around the board, buy spaces (Amigas), expand them, and collect rent from other players (when they visit them). The player who remains solvent last - wins! The rest will unfortunately go bankrupt
Amiga Bomber 2.0
A Scorched Earth style two player shooter duel game from Markus Gayda of Soaring Software that came out in 1993.
Amiga Borders

Amiga Borders is the (German) implementation of the famous “Kästchen Ziehn” or cheese boxes board game - one of the most sensible uses for squared paper that I know! The aim here is to get the most squares filled in, and more than your human or computer opponent. Each board is filled with dots on a grid. Each turn a human or computer draw a line between points. If 3 of the lines are filled, the next person can close the block and score a point for themselves. If you enclose a block you get another chance to put down a line. Late in the game this can lead to a train of blocks being filled. The most filled at the end wins! You can also design these patterns yourself using an included editor.
Amiga Boulder Dash

Amiga Boulder Dash is, unsurprisingly, a Boulder Dash variant. It features two different versions of the game and a construction kit.

In each level you must collect a certain number of diamonds in order to open a portal to the next stage while avoiding flying enemies and falling boulders.
Amiga Bridge
Amiga Bridge plays, unsurprisingly, the game bridge. It supports a subset of the bidding system and is the first non-commercial bridge program available for the Amiga.
Amiga Castles V2.01
Amiga Castles v2.01 is a freeware workbench game released by Dirk Wachtel (aka Count Diwi) in 1994. A small strategy game for two players after the old Atari game template.
Amiga Christmas Story

An AMOS based text adventure created by Pedro Fernández as a Christmas gift to you and about a Christmas gift to you. Written in AMOS Professional. Coding, digitised graphics & music by Pedro Fernández (Rockersuke); audio samples by Johan Brodd (JoBro) and infobandit.
Amiga Columns

Amiga Columns is a shareware take on the puzzle arcade game Columns. Your mission is to match blocks of the same color in order to remove them. Another Tetris variant that was originally developed for MS-DOS (X-Windows) and converted by the author. It looks very simple at first - but long-lasting fun is guaranteed! Key control via 'j', 'k', 'l' and the space bar.

Amiga Encounter

Encounter! is a fast paced arcade game set in a sci-fi environment which features fast moving three dimensional graphics. You command a probe vehicle with which you have to shoot down enemy saucers and homing missiles. When you have shot down the required number of enemies on one level (usually around 10-20) you get the chance to go through a "stargate". In the stargate you have to navigate through a hail of spheres coming at you at high speed. If you succeed you get to a new planet in different color scheme, if you fail you'll have to replay the previous planet. There's eight levels in total.

Amiga GnuChess
Amiga GnuChess is port of Gnu Chess 4.0. You can use mouse to all (valid) moves, edit the board, ask for help and switch players at any time.
Amiga Hextris
Hexagonal Tetris, so each piece has six rotations instead of just four from David Markley and Markus Wild from 1990. It was also forked under the same name by Jeff W Teague with improvements.
Amiga International Soccer

Amiga Soccer (alias International Soccer) is a soccer game in which two teams play against each other. The match itself can be varied with many settings, e.g. difficulty level, weather, half-time length or time of day, but there are no additional playing modes like a league to be found. However, the basic tactical approach can be set before starting the match.

When not in ball possession, the active athlete can be switched by pressing a button and the opponent can be tackled. The strength of a kick depends on how long the fire button is pressed.
Amiga Karate

Amiga Karate (Karate/ST Karate) is a 2D one-on-one fighting game similar to World Karate Championship. The player controls a karate fighter through different stages that become more difficult over time. Fights take place against a single opponent and the health bars of the two are shown near the top of the screen. The character starts with three lives and additional ones can be gained by reaching certain scores.

When holding a button or key pressed the controls include moving backwards and forwards, jump, duck, high punch and mid punch, front somersault and block. When that button or key is released the controls offer turning, high kick, mid kick, low kick, high back kick, jump kick, foot kick and back somersault. Fights are fast-paced and require a lot of hit and run tactics.
Amiga Kniffel
A Yahtzee style, German language Public Domain game written in BASIC.
Amiga Lazer Zone

Amiga Lazer Zone is based on Jeff Minter's 1983 shoot'em'up Laser Zone for c64. It has you controlling not one, but two "zone gunners" in a constrained playfield. Controlled with only one joystick, you move one zone gunner on a vertical wall and one at the bottom. 

Wave upon wave of nasties come into the zone and must be shot down before they reach either wall, where they will advance towards the gun, finally destroying it.
Amiga Lykkehjulet

Lykkehjulet is the Danish version of the Wheel of Fortune television game show. Airing in 1988, the show was the first big American game show to be imported and just 2 years later Damo Soft put out this version of the game for the Amiga.
Amiga Majong

A one or two player shareware Majong game from Danny Y. Wong in 1995. Mah Jong is an ancient Chinese game that consists of 144 tiles, the 144 tiles are broken down into the following 4 groups:
Circles: 36 tiles
Bamboos: 36 tiles
Characters: 36 tiles
Words: 28 tiles
Flowers: 8 tiles
Match up all your tiles in a three tile run sequence or 3 or 4 of a king before all 144 tiles have been taken from the deck or someone else wins. The player who starts the round receives 14 random tiles and the rest get 13.
Amiga Man
Amiga Man is a Mega Man/Rockman style platform game developed and released by Mainake Project and placed 4th in the Posadas 2026 Homebrew Games competition.
Amiga Master Mind

Playing Amiga Master Mind is very simple: after loading the program, the game's start screen appears after just a few seconds. You can read a summary of the basic Master Mind rules—which are likely familiar to almost everyone—via the "Instructions" option in the "Options" menu. To start a game, simply select the "Start Game" menu option. The computer will ask you to select the number of players from the "Players" menu; if playing with two people, after entering the players' names, the Codemaker (the person setting the sequence to be guessed) must enter the combination by clicking on the colored pegs and, once they have had a chance to note it down, can begin the game. 
 
If, however, there is only one player, the computer takes on the role of the code-maker, while the player acts as the code-breaker (the one who must guess the sequence).

Combinations must consist exclusively of five pegs of different colors.

Amiga Othello

Back in 1985, the first Amiga 1000 computers came with the ABasiC programming language by Metacomco. Unfortunately ABasiC does not work under Kickstart 2.0 (V36) and later, but can be patched to fix the problem. David Addison wrote some excellent games in ABasiC including Amiga Othello, written in 1986. 

The David Addison games originally appeared on Fred Fish disks 28. Amiga Othello is an implementation of the board game of the same name. Players take turns placing tokens on the board, tokens that are surrounded by two tokens of another color change color. When the board is full, the player with the most tokens of their color on the board wins the game.
Amiga Pets

Amiga Puzzle
An AMOS based freeware puzzle from Grzegorz Gajkowski of Grino Studio. It allows you to rearrange the puzzle into a scene of sexual debauchery of the best kind.
Amiga Q

A single player remove the peg style board game created in 1990 by Thomas-Paul Shultz and published as a coverdisk on Amiga Action #62. Jump pegs to an empty spot to remove them and try to remove all but one!
Amiga Quiz 2.0
A shareware quiz developed and published by Techware in 1994. Wonderful German quiz program with tons of Amiga related questions.
Amiga Redpill Racing
"Redpill Racing" is a top-down-view racer, which was created bt Hyabde3050 in 2017 using the Game Construction Kit Redpill.
Amiga Rescue

Amiga Rescue is a new retro-style puzzle game for the Commodore Amiga, inspired by the machine we still love repairing and upgrading decades later.

Across 50 levels, you'll work your way through a series of faulty Amigas, restoring broken circuit-board traces and getting each machine running again.

The rules are simple: click the circuit pieces to rotate them and create a complete path across the board. But as the repairs become more complicated, you'll also need to deal with diodes that only allow current to flow in one direction and those old Amiga favourites, leaky capacitors.
Amiga Resident Evil
A demo of a point and click style, visual novel version of Resident Evil for the Amiga, the full game by Aaron Holt was never finished. The demo was released in 1998.
Amiga Risk

Amiga Risk is a computer adaptation of the well known board game. The game is played on a world map where the objective is to take control of all 42 territories. The game is played by three to six generals that can be human or AI controlled. 

There are several different computer generals to choose from, each having their own character and strategy with varying difficulty. The game features hi-def graphics and clean interface.
Amiga Robbo
Robbo is a cross between Boulder Dash and Sokoban that has no sound or music as creatd by Robert Szacki of RNS Vision, this version also incorporates elements of Chips Challenge.
Amiga Robots

A freeware 2-player game created by Hanno Behrens. It's an avoid it game, don't let anything touch you, maneuver to make robots crash into each other for added times. Beat you highest move count and run the high scores if you are able.
Amiga Roulette
Amiga Roulette is a German roulette simulator for 1-4 players.
Amiga Scrabble

A shareware scrabble game for up to four players created by Martin Powell and published in 1994. Welcome to Martin Powell's AMIGA SCRABBLE. Scrabble is a game for 2, 3 or 4 human players. Play consists of forming interlocking words, crossword fashion, on the scrabble board, using letter tiles with various score values.

Each player competes for the highest score by using his tiles in combinations and locations that take best advantage of letter values and premium squares on the board. An up to the minute scoresheet can be seen by licking on the Score icon. Any words listed in a standard dictionary are permitted,except those spelt with an initial capital letter, abbreviations,
prefixes and suffixes and words requiring apostrophes or hyphens. Save and load previous game is disabled in unregistered versions.
Amiga Sokoban

A Sokoban inspired freeware game created by Lorens Younes and Panagiotis Christias using C and ReAction in 1996. In it you play the warehouse keeper and in this puzzle you must push boxes around in a warehouse, trying to get them to storage locations. The game is played on a board of squares, where each square is a floor or a wall. Some floor squares contain boxes, and some floor squares are marked as storage locations.

The player is confined to the board and may move horizontally or vertically onto empty squares (never through walls or boxes). To move a box, the player walks up to it and pushes it to the square beyond. Boxes cannot be pulled, and they cannot be pushed to squares with walls or other boxes. The number of boxes equals the number of storage locations. The puzzle is solved when all boxes are placed at storage locations.
Amiga Solitaire

Released in English and eventually in Polish, this solitaire game was created by David W. Meny and Albert Penello and released in 1991. An Amiga implementation of the "Klondike" solitaire with a totally mouse-driven, OS-friendly interface. There are settings for if the game should keep times, if the deck should be flipped one or three cards at a time, how many times one may flip through the deck, an undo function and a cheat function to glimpse through a stack. There are six decks to choose from, including one with the Amiga checkmark and one with a Batman theme.
Amiga Spiele 1

The Amiga Spiele 1 is a Markt & Technik compilation of three low-budget games developed in Germany that were never released elsewhere. The following games are included:

1) Wikinger

As the name suggests, Wikinger is a strategical conquest game taking place in Northern Europe around 900 A.D.. The initial choice to be made is how many human players shall participate, the number ranges from five people down to zero with the latter option boiling down to watching five computer-controlled players battle it out. Of course, there are precisely five nations to choose from that are in desperate need of a leader, namely Iceland, England, Sweden, Denmark, and Norway. As the goal of the game is to conquer as much land as possible, Iceland is, for geographical reasons, by far the hardest nation to succeed with, where Denmark is the easiest.

Every nation starts the game with one single staging post that controls 10 villages.

Amiga Superball II

A freeware avoid it game created by Michael Mueller of Axival Software, the 2001 game was rescued and re-released in 2016. This is a vertically scrolling avoid it game. You can adjust the speed during the game F1 - F3 keys change. Would you like to save this setting then press the S key, then there is a short pause, which gives the computer some time to adjust the setting into one file to be saved in the same directory as the ASBII file is secured.
Amiga Wheel of Fortune
A two player Wheel of Fortune with voice synthesis game created by Kent Shafer in 1988, based on the TV show of the same name.
Amiga Win Fruit Machine

A freeware slot\fruit machine program made by Tim Quigley of Madsoft Inc in 1997 using Blitz BASIC, with a sequel released the next year. It's a fruit machine, nuff said. Oh yeah, to quit press escape or click on the tiny Q gadget in the top left hand corner.

Commodore * 3 = £ 0.50
Yin Yang * 3 = £ 1.00
Check * 3 = £ 1.00
Sphere * 3 = £ 2.00
Bar * 3 = £ 5.00
Skull * 3 = £ 7.50
Gateway * 3 = £10.00 
 

Also, if you get a matching pair of symbols on the first two reels you win 20p.
Amiga World Golf

World Golf is a Sports game, developed and published by Apex Systems, which was released in 1996. An addictive and truly original golf game for 1 to 4 players in practice and tournament modes. Five authentic courses from around the world. Five Skill levels. Select between 1, 2, 4 or 18 hole rounds. Auto and manual club selection. Ambient sound effects, realistic ball actions and far more!
Amiga-Invaders

In near future, thrilling discovery was made. The inevitable invasion comes to the cradle of humanity. Researches shows that it can be stopped only by the specially crafted technology. There is not much time to contact. Only ten effective fighters will be constructed in time. Humanity need to send only the best pilots. Jump behind the simulator rudders. Be in the elite ten and save humanity from invasion.
Amiga-Win
Amiga-Win is a slot machine simulator with, instead of fruits, has Amiga-themed pictures on its wheels.
Amigaboy Tetris

Amigaboy Tetris runs a mockery gameboy emulator (Mintendo's Amiga Boy) and plays Gameboy's Tetris, possibly the most played Tetris conversion in existence as it was included with the Game Boy upon its release in several territories.
AmigaByte #11

Coverdisk 11 content:

Goblins (Full PD Game)
Tetrix (Full PD Game)
AmigaByte #14

Coverdisk 14 content:

Gold (Full PD Game)
AmiGalaga
Galaga for the Amiga 500: a port of the 1981 arcade game, written in 68000 assembly for a stock A500 (OCS, 512 KB of chip RAM, Kickstart 1.3, PAL).
Amigalek

Six programs for Swedish preschool or elementary school age children. A rich game compilation that combines both math, coloring of pictures and reading of short words. You must also match things such as hen and egg. A very rich educational package.
Amiganitzu

30 levels of frustrating fun! Collect all the keys and then exit via the door. Spiders will kill you if you are caught adjacent to them. Spiders will explode if they can no longer move. Snakes will spit deadly poison if you are in their line of site. Be quick or the traps will get you, but they can be blocked with boulders. Collect gems for extra points and extra lives.
Amiganoid

Amiganoid is a breakout clone game, developed by Digital Illusions and published by Amiga Format for free as a Public Domain and was released in 1993.

As the name might indicate, Amiganoid is a Arkanoid variant made for the Amiga. It follows the gameplay of the original game closely, but it has an extra paddle on the right side of the screen. The bottom and right sides of the screen are both gaps to avoid losing the ball into. You have to destroy all bricks on the screen by bouncing a ball off the paddles. Some bricks requires two hits to break, while some others can't be destroyed at all. The longer you have the ball in the air, the quicker the and harder the game will be. When breaking all the bricks on a level you will go on to the next level. In total there is 25 different levels.
AmigaTration
A "Concentration" game for the Amiga, where you must locate matching tiles on a grid that can range from 4x4 (easy) to 12x12 (difficult). Up to four players.
AmiGo

AmiGo was one of the first Go programs publicly available with source code. It is based on a Pascal program written by Stoney Ballard in 1983 and posted to USENET and was ported to C and the Amiga by Todd R. Johnson in 1989. Multiple updates and releases have been made to this game over the years with v6.3 being released in
Amigo the Fox

Amigo the Fox is a full length recreation of Mike Wiering's Mario for DOS, ported as an open-source flagship sample game for the Scorpion Engine.

Minimum 1MB A500. A1200 recommended.
Amigoids

Amigoids is a one or two player Asteroids game.

It has three game modes: single player; two players; one player with two ships. There is a high score table, joystick support and extra ships are granted for every 10,000 points scored. You start in a small Space Ship in the center of the screen, you are equipped with bullets, and your aim is to shoot the asteroids along with any flying saucers which appear throughout each level

You can move around the screen slowly or even at speed, But you must not collide with the asteroids or even the flying saucers, as this will cost you a life, The aim is to clear the level of the asteroids by shooting them, when they are hit, they gradually split into smaller and smaller pieces, which fly off in different directions, again you hit these, and they get smaller and smaller, until you hit the last piece which then disappears off screen, at this point you have completed hitting that asteroid

There are many asteroids per level of course, which will st...
AmiGTA
A native AmigaOS 68k port of Grand Theft Auto (1997), targeting classic hardware — 68020 and up, AGA or RTG. Not PiStorm, not Vampire, not Emu68.
AmiGuess

A freeware puzzle game for one user created by Gareth Murfin who fashioned himself the head of Alpha Software in 1997. Touted as a complex game of intrigue and mystery, but in reality it is a guessing game. Guess the number the computer determined. It will let you know if you need to guess higher or lower. The game was made specifically for entry into the Amiga Format readers game section!
AmiKiss

A Paper-doll game for changing clothes. Kiss is based on a popular Japanese game called 'Kisekae' that translates
to "changing clothes". The game involves manipulating and overlaying items of clothing over the bodies of popular Japanese anime characters. This game is not restricted to just changing clothes on people either. Kiss data is available for battleships and mecha too. 

Three sets have been included in this archive - sallyez.lzh, mogami.lzh and asukakis.lzh. These should be unarchived into separate directories.

This program is thanks to all the other Amiga programmers out there that have created software to make the Amiga such an excellent platform and fun computer. It is ShareWare game created by Victor Ng-Thow-Hing.
AmiKlotski
A simple yet quite difficult puzzle game for Commodore Amiga.
AmiLines Deluxe
Align sets of 5 or more colored balls in lines to score. the bigger the lines, the more you score. Game ends when the field is full.
Amilunch

First Amiga implementation of a widespread combination logic and skill game (Klack). Balls are thrown into a standing upright game board and then fall to different heights (based on the logic of the locking rockers) - thereby changing how the next ball will flor. Determine where to drop and how to arrange them for the best score... For 1 or 2 players.
Limited demo version (only two different game options of the game; the full version currently contains: 13).
Shareware from Detlef Schäfer in 1994.
AmiMineSweeper
MineSweeper (final release) for any Amiga. Game is system-friendly and working on kickstart 1.3 and laters. It's my first game on system Intuition Screen.
AMIner

An arcade style underground mining game created by Last Minute Creations and ranked 2nd in Retrokomp 2018 game development contest. Each level provides a dollar value goal that must be met within the time limit to move on to the next. The game is set in a Communist theme. You have been sent to this facility by the decision of Ministry of Mining and Fossile Fuels. The outpost is small but we believe not yet fully explored and examined. As you know, development of our great Democratic Peoples Republic requires significant expenditures in the sector of heavy industry. Industry that will astound and amaze with its creations not only imperialist in the West but the whole world. Industry that is so important for our great Army that protects our Motherland and helps to liberate more and more nations from the imperial and capitalist occupant.
AmiOmega

Omega is usually considered the first roguelike game with a traditional plot. AmiOmega is Omega's Amiga port; named differently on the platform due to Origin's tank design/programming game "Omega" released the previous year.

In AmiOmega, you play a protagonist that has been transported to another world by the Omega Project. You are trying to become an Adept, a person of immense power who follows the Buddhism-like principles of the Lords of Omega, by undergoing a series of quests.
Amipssst

A homebrew port of the Ultimate Play the Game classic where growing the best TMC possible is the sole purpose of Robbie the Robot. When insects invade his garden, he has to stop them ruining his work. He has a canister of insect repellent, a smoke-bomb and a startling streamer, each placed on walls at the side of his garden. Each will stun any particular vermin, but you will need to find out exactly what kills what.

As the plant grows, aided by the timely addition of compost bags, leaves will start to shoot outwards. The more leaves there are, the quicker it will grow (a simple incorporation of the concept of photosynthesis being boosted by having more sunlight absorbed), so don't let the bugs near it - those whose programmed movement path takes them towards an existing leaf should be your priority. Once the plant is high enough, it flowers and you move onto another level, where increasingly tough foes are on the prowl.
AmiQuest 2.0: Enheter
A Swedish educational game from Stefan Lundberg that was released in 1990.
AmiQuest 2.0: Klockan
A Swedish language educational game featuring reading the clock from Stefan Lundberg and released in 1991.
AmiQuest 2.0: Lästräning
A Swedish-language educational game, focused on reading comprehension and training created by Stefan Lundberg and Jonas Lundberg, both part of SweComp and published by SPAB in 1991.
AmiRobbo

After an attack by the forces of the Xenox Empire on the Princess Izra's fortress, the last handful of defenders have surrendered and you have taken charge. They looted the princess palace hoping to capture her but Robbo, Princess Izra's protective robot is there, with his powerful weapons he destroy's some enemies, giving the princess valuable time to escape in her super fast Starfighter but he eventually gets captured.

Robbo is imprisoned on a remote Xenox System and deprived of his weapons and ammunition. Robbo breaks out of prison but he finds the base abandoned. There are only a few broken escape pods left and Robbo has to collect all the screws from the entire base in order to fix the escape pods and return home.

Can he escape, It's up to you.
AmiSaber

An Unofficial port of BeatSaber to the Commodore Amiga.
This is (clearly) not an exact clone of Beatsaber. It is only meant for fun and becouse it was possible to do! 
Any Song can be easily converted into the program. The converter and the Amos source code are also inclouded in the RAR file.
AmiSeaFox

Celebrate 40 years of the Commodore Amiga with AmiSeaFox Demo, an explosive tribute to the classic SeaFox! Dive into this reimagined version for the Amiga, where your mission is clear: destroy the entire enemy fleet before you run out of torpedoes or fuel
Amishion Impossible

An entry into the itch.io 2018 Seven Day First Person Shooter Jam, coded entirely between the 20th and 27th of October. The game is set in a fictional 2004,four years after the horrific events of Y2K, where appliances rule the world and only those who shunned them are free from their tyranny. Eventually, the mechano men come for your farm on the edge of Philadelphia. Use your goodly shotgun and your pitchfork to take out the tech terrors, mayhaps you'll find more weapons along the way.
AmiSnakes

A snake-game for an Amiga.

 - Single player or Two players mode (split screen)

 - 6 different worlds

 - adventure story mode
AmiSports

Get ready for a whole new sporting challenge on your Commodore Amiga!

AmiSports is a colourful 3D sports collection featuring 10 different sporting events, customisable characters, computer opponents and local multiplayer.

Built from the ground up using the Ami3D engine, AmiSports brings a fun, accessible sports-party experience to classic Amiga hardware.
Amitron

A game from Assassins CD 4, an overly complicated front end for a worm\Tron style game with some added features like customizable maps, caging your opponent and some interesting devices that can impact play. You can even modify each user to have different amounts of lives, jumps, teleports, breakthroughs and the aforementioned cages.
AmiUklandanka
A 1991 freeware puzzle game created by Grzegorz Gajkowsk of Grino Studio. Sort the image parts to make a cohesive whole single picture.
Amiwalé

Amiwalé is a wordplay on Awelé, one of the many names of the traditional Ghanaian board game Owale played around Africa and throughout the Caribbean. 

The game has a board and 48 seeds. The objective of the game is to capture more seeds than one's opponent. 

The game features extensive instructions on the rules how to play the game, mutiple difficulty levels and the possibility to make both players be played by the computer.
Amnios

Amnios is a multi-directionally scrolling top down shoot 'em up set across ten levels, each representing a planet whose eco-system has been infected. The controls involved thrusting and rotating, similarly to Asteroids.

There are two ways to successfully complete the level - destroy enough of the infection to allow the planet to survive, or rescue enough of the citizens, Defender-style. For each of the organs to be destroyed, a specific weapon can be created to cleanse it easier - blueprints must be collected and taken back to your ship for this.
Amoeba Invaders

Amoeba Invaders is a single player, keyboard or joystick controlled, Space Invaders clone.

Gameplay is pretty much the same as all other games of this type, the player has a cannon which can move left and right. It hides behind four houses that are gradually reduced to rubble before being completely destroyed by a screen full of descending alien ships. Every so-often a mother ship flies across of the screen. During the game an extra base is awarded when the score exceeds 1500 points, but there is only one extra base per game.

One feature this game has which many games do not is that the player can choose map their own keys to the Left/Right/Fire and Pause actions. When a game is over the high score for the gaming session is updated but it is not saved for later and the player is not prompted for their name/initials.
Amoeba Strip 69

Amoeba Strip 69 is tic-tac-toe variant where you need to get five in a row to win. Possibly the only adult tic-tac-toe game in the existence, you'll get rewarded with a topless picture after each win.
Amok

An AMOS based shareware action game created by Chris Hurst of Kings Guild Software and released in 1991. Your robot is trapped in a strange world which is unstable. To escape the robot must fit 150 micro-chips into his teleporter. The chips appear randomly along with bombs and holes. There's also a robotic ghost to avoid.
Amok Update
A shareware game created by Christian Hurst and published in 1991 by Kings Guild Software.
Amos Alley
Shoot the bad guys and NOT the good guys!! Extra points for exceptional speed. A public domain game created by Dean Prunier and released as PD in 1992.
AMOS Asteroids

Contains four versions of the old Asteroids game. On version 1 all graphics are computed rather than drawn by an artist. Disc contains full documentation. The game is played with a joystick and the objective is to destroy as many levels of rocks as possible and to destroy the alien ship when it appears. Treat yourself to a trip down memory lane or show the kids what games used to be like. A freeware game created in AMOS by Mike Widdess and released in 1991.
AMOS Coin Drop
Slot machine for up to four players. One of the features is "Nudge"; when you get those, you can choose to flip one of the wheels to the direction you want for as many times as you have nudges.
AMOS Cricket

AMOS Cricket is a cricket simulator that features, among other things, various skill levels that are independently adjustable, preset teams and a team editor. As the editor also works mid-game, one of the features is a built-in cheat engine, should you wish to do so. 

The game is played from a top-down perspective and requires both mouse and joystick as the batsman is played with the joystick and the bowler with the mouse.
Amos Defence

You are the lone defender of the great interplanetary starship AMOS and have to resist a surprise attack from an alien race intent on the destruction of the whole Amos race. Attacking ships are loaded with explosives and try to evade your fire to make kamikaze attacks on your base ship. It is believed they will abandon their attempt if you can destroy 250 of their number, but the more you destroy, the more persistent they become! They will send faster ships and try to target you for explosives instead of the base ship. Look out for rotating mines, if you get too close you'll be cosmic dust.
AMOS Fruit Machine

A four reel pub style fruit\slot machine. Intended to be, "...as near as possible, an exact copy of the sort of Fruit Machine you find in any snooker hall or members club. It was created with AMOS and published by Mandrin/Jawx in 1991.
AMOS Invaders

Amos Invaders by SM Sutton is a version of the old classic Space invaders which is very well done with aliens which get faster and faster as the game progresses. The game often is found in a two pack with Creepy Crawly.
AMOS Maths Calculator

A math instruction game that covers Area and Volume, Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication, Division, Fractions and
Percent. Future updates were planned for Trigonometry, but it is unclear if it came to pass. On loading you are presented with a menu. You must use the numbers on the keypad not the keyboard. There is speech when you complete a set number of questions. Well produced program to help you solidify your math knowledge by Simon Jewell in 1991.
AMOS Monopoly
Released as part of The Classics Collection, Monopoly from Horbinder Singh Ghag gives the feeling of the original board game and is for up to four players. It was created using AMOS in 1992.
AMOS Quizmaster

An AMOS based quiz game created by Mark Venn and released in 1991. Different versions of this game exist, some PD, others shareware. The game has a built-in question\game editor for making your own quizzes. The quizzes are presented 10 questions at a time.
AMOS Tenpin Bowling & LogiCircuit

Never released separately, this compilation is a strange combination of a bowling simulator and a puzzle game by the same developer.

AMOS Tenpin Bowling is a bowling game for one or two players.

LogiCircuit is a puzzle game where your mission is to connect logic circuit from a to b through a circuit board by using various gates.
AMOS-Hangman

This version of hangman has versions for children and adults. The children's version has a sequence of soldiers marching on the unfortunate prisoner, for each wrong guess another soldier brings on part of the gallows and the prisoner shows signs of great despair, if you guess correctly, he jumps for joy! I found this idea quite amusing even if rather macabre, look out for the final sequence. The adult version has different animation with various parts of the hanged man being added for each incorrect answer.
Amotrix

This is another Tetris variation with some updated ideas. First there is a new object, a drop which fills five free fields in the playfield using a special algorithm. Then there is an energy bar ,which you can increase by pulling the stick down and decrement by pressing the joystick up. Meaning, the falling speed of the object is controlled by the joystick so you have very granular control of the speed at all times, as long as you have sufficient energy to control it. Finally, in two player mode when one side gets a line cleared, the other the opponent loses a field. There are 3 difficulty levels. Firing on your joystick rotates the shape. There is also a field showing the next shape up in the queue. 
 
If the game play is too fast, press H to halve the speed of the game, however, this will also halve the amount of points gained.
AMPU
A clone of Total Wormage. Being such big fans of WORMS, Finnish developers, Naamahaukat got permission to use some of the samples from Team 17's game for their clone.
AMRVoxel
A game created by Black Five SoftDesign as an open sourced game, created with ASM 68k and AMOS. Drive your Voxel car, keep it on the road and you'll go far.
AMRWolf

Having recently rediscovered some old projects, I thought I'd share the final Work-in-progress version of AMRWolf, a Texture-mapped raycasting engine writtenin a mixture of AMOSPro and assembly language.

Compared with the original demo released in 1996, this version has a couple of extra levels, a map editor and comes with full source.
Amy's Fun-2-3 Adventure!

Amy's Fun-2-3 Adventure is, according to the accompanying documentation, a commercial-quality edutainment game teaching math.

There are four games included in this package, all involving Amy, an animated cartoon dog. Three of the four games are math-based, and pretty basic for learning numbers. The fourth game is a music-based game where, using a virtual xylophone, you play classic kid's songs by hitting the correctly numbered keys or by reading the notes.
Anaconda
A snake game created by Centori Software Productions and released by the infamous Courbois Software in 1990.
Analogies I

The first in a duo of quiz\word games from Intellectual Software, this one released by Queue Inc in 1986. The games were created in AmigaBASIC. In them you are quizzed to help you analyze, solve, and practice analogies to improve scores on college aptitude tests.
Anarchy

As a Defender variant, Anarchy is a side-scrolling parallax shooter, in which you take on the evil Anarchists and their destructive behaviour. Your ship moves left or right on a looping level, shooting the enemies and finally the bosses. You have a single life with gradually draining energy. No less than 50 High Scores are recorded.

There are no surprises in gameplay, except the usual upgrades for your ship - X-shaped pods reveal circles, which can be collected to produce multiple fire beams, multi-directional shots, and drones with advanced cannons
Anatomic Man

Anatomic Man is a vertically-scrolling shoot-'em-up where you control a shrunken-down spaceship flying around inside the human body, in a similar setup to the classic 1966 sci-fi film, Fantastic Voyage. As the game opens you see the tiny yellow ship fly into a wide-open human mouth, and the first level is down the gullet, where your enemies are food fragments that can damage the ship. Joystick controls are used to pilot the ship.
Ancient Domains of Mystery

In Ancient Domains of Mystery, the player character is an adventurer who has traveled to a remote mountain range to save Ancardia, the world of the game, from the forces of Chaos. The player can either continue on with this quest or join on with Chaos, depending on the choices that the player makes in the game. Becoming corrupted by the forces of chaos causes mutations which have positive or negative effects.

The game features a wide range of character races and classes, a point-based skill system, many subplots, and a detailed world which allows to grow herbs and repair/upgrade weapons with smithing.
Ancient Games

Get ready for mega-playable sports action in Ancient Games! Compete in different events in this ancient marathon to win gold coins. As a slave, buy your freedom with your winnings - and then climb the social ladder as you win even more!
Andora

This is a preview of the adventure game ANDORA: Forest Prison made by Eric Cubizolle and Sylvain Martinez. In the final version there will be 5 areas: the forest, the village, the temple, the two others. The story is inspired by several fantastic events. The action takes place as you must discover what is at the heart of such a forest where one cannot escape. It has 64 colors. 188 wanderers per level... or 588 screens in total, 1 to 5 different languages. Ability to speak with the characters.
Android Arena
Android Arena is an action game where you must move an android around each level shooting any enemies and avoiding any flames that might happen to be bursting from the floor boards.
Andromeda

Andromeda is a science fiction arcade game. The action takes place in the Year 2317 inside a space base localized in a Andromeda star system, near a star which will soon explode. Controlling the robot MSQ-2 the player must find all parts of the supercomputer. Unfortunately the defence system ceased to function properly and the player will have to avoid the hostile units and defence stations. Switching off the defense system requires finding four magnetic cards with secret codes. The game features around 150 locations divided into a few levels connected with elevator system. Some of the doors require collecting proper access cards, force fields and traps may switch off. Contact with hostile units and defence traps takes some energy. The energy level may be purchased in the computer for the money scattered around the base.
Andromeda Mission

Somewhere in the far reaches of space, an epic battle is taking place.

As a lone hero, you fly your ship into the screen Space Harrier style, though a scrolling alien planet, shooting any enemies that approach. Pods offering improved weapons are unleashed regularly After you get through the waves of aliens, you must destroy a mother ship. Then you blast off into space, fighting your way to the next planet. Can you survive all sixteen planets in the Andromeda Mission? We will see.
Angband

Angband is a member of the roguelike RPGs.

The goal of the game is to descend in the dungeons and become powerful enough to defeat the evil Morgoth at the bottom of the dungeon.

Angband is an updated version of the game Moria, adding more monsters, character races and classes; deepening the dungeon from 50 levels to 100; and including such new features as monster pits and unique items.
Angband (Randy Hutson and Simon Raybould)

Angband is a single-player, text-based, dungeon simulation derived from the game Moria, an enhancement of the old unix game Rogue. It is often described as a "roguelike" game because the look and feel of the game is still quite similar to Rogue.

Angband features many enhancements over Moria: unique foes, artifacts, monster pits and vaults to name a few. Many of these new creatures and objects are drawn from the writings of J.R.R Tolkien, although some of the monsters come straight from classical mythology, Dungeons & Dragons, Rolemaster, or the minds of the orginal Angband coders.

The ultimate goal of the game is to develop a character strong enough to defeat Morgoth, who lurks around dungeon level 100. Upon doing so, you will receive the exalted status of "winner" and your character may retire.

Angband is a reference to Morgoth's "prison of iron."
Angel Nieto Pole 500

Angel Nieto Pole 500 is a motorcycle game based on the 500cc World Championship, starring the Spanish legend Angel Nieto (13 World Championship titles in the 50cc and 125cc classes between 1969 and 1984).

This game allows to choose between various number of game modes with the primary target to beat all rivals. Other available options include multiplayer, motorcycle characteristics, circuit or meteorology.

And then, in the World Championship you can choose another option: see the stats of your competitors (his times in the trainings, records and position in start line), also you can run the official training on each circuit to be placed on the best position to start the race.

The game includes 16 circuits in total (the official of this competition), you can try it by separate to train, but if you want to win the title you must to show your abilities in each one of them since the first.
Angst
Angst is an first person 3D shooter game, developed by Rave Software and published by DEM Software, which was released in Europe in 1995. The pre-release/prototype version was called Paranoia.
Anguish
Anguish is the spiritual sequel to Agony for AGA Amigas.
Animal Land
Animal Land is an edutainment title for small children that helps to learn the living conditions of different animals.
Aniso

Aniso is a puzzle game, that is simple to understand but hard to master. In it, you have two grids (from 3*3 to 8*8). One of the grids is filled with numbers while the other one is empty. The idea behind the game is to form an image of the first grid to the second. When you click one of the squares inside the grid, the square and its immediate neighbors will get a "1" in them. The numbers will be incremented by one on each click, with a wraparound after four. Additionally, you can only click a square just once.
Ankhrapt

An early look at a Polish, space strategy demo prepared by the well-known Deck Six group. A strategy in which the player discovers and conquers new planets and develops life on them. While colonizing the universe, he encounters other races with whom he can trade, negotiate and fight. Some Aliens are friendly, others immediately declare war. Individual races also differ in technological advancement.
Annals of Rome

Annals of Rome begins in 273BC and sets you as a Roman senator, with the ultimate aim of colonizing as much of the known world as possible, and retaining that power against Carthaginians, Vandals, Parthians, Persians and all the other world forces. You have a strong army at your disposal, and can direct your generals as to which countries they attempt to invade.

The game is turn-based, and these turns operate in phases, beginning with the economic circumstances of population and tax income being decided - it's recommended to keep taxation taxing low unless things become desperate. The game then updates you on the statuses of your generals, and give you the chance to redistribute them to other parts of your kingdom.

Officers may rebel and cause a civil war - fortunately this can usually be pre-empted. More serious are attempts to take land from other civilizations, which take place in order and include conflicts between other groups.
Annihilation

A game made by Graham Humphrey and Mihcael, Marco Pedrana and Jason Hill as the team named Underground Arcade. It was written in Blitz BASIC, mostly finished in 2016 and released as Public Domain. A horizontally scrolling space shooter of the usual sort with power-ups, waves of enemies, end-of-level bosses… you name it! It feature seven (count ‘em) themed levels: space, a strange alien forest, a strange alien desert, arctic, a ruined city (and not a strange alien in sight), a volcano and finally, the base (a strange alien one, naturally).
Annoyotron

Annoyotron is a text adventure that proudly announces itself the most annoying game of all time. While I'm sure a few developers would take serious issue with that statement, I don't see them really winning an argument on the subject.

Annoyotron breaks new ground as it is one of a virtual handful of games that do not seek, ultimately, to be entertainment. The effect that most games wish to bring forth from their audience is one of "player fun." It is almost law. A game designed to stimulate its player in a different way is rare, yes -- but still, most of those games attempt to incorporate a good time within their processes.

Annoyotron offers no such escapes, no such virtue. It is fundamentally impossible to have a good time playing Annoyotron. Unless one is somehow able to force another soul into experiencing it with the promise that a hilarious endgame awaits.
Anoid

A Blitz basic Arkanoid clone with gravity and HAM mode GFX by Uffe Jakobsen in 1999. You are a downright annoying kid! As such, you have a fondness for braking stuff. And that makes your parents very ANOID. Be very annoying and we will capture you in the 5 most annoying kids!
Another World: The Lost Level

This level has now been brought back to the Amiga 
Designed by: Eric Chahi (adapted for Amiga by Earok)
Answer Back Senior Quiz

Answer Back: Senior Quiz is a Quiz game, developed and published by Kosmos, which was released in 1990.

Quizzes are popular with everyone. Quizzes combined with Space-Age sound and colorful graphics are irresistible. Quizzes containing a vast selection of well-researched questions have immense educational value. The ANSWER BACK quiz provides a unique adventure in education by allowing the successful challenger to participate in a simple and compelling game.
Answer Back: Junior Quiz

Answer Back: Junior Quiz is an Educational game, developed and published by Kosmos, which was released in 1990. Game provides a unique adventure in education by allowing the successful challenger to participate in a simple and compelling game. The software package contains a highly sophisticated control program and fifteen thought-provoking quizzes, each covering a different topic in general knowledge.

Game of questions and answers with numerous options, in which a game of "Dragons and Princesses" is combined with questions oriented to children of 6 and 12 years.
Ant Wars

Earth was destroyed in a global cataclysm caused by the amoeba which had caused the earth to flip over on its acis and fly towards the sun causing a super-nova. Eddy Littler, a man of immense wealth, managed to escape in his private space ship. Consequently, so did a colony of ants living in Eddy's dreadlocks.

More of a strategy game than its sequel, Ant Wars is a hybrid between Artillery games and Worms.
Ant Wars II

After the first few millenia of happily obliterating each other, the two separate species of ants, the blacks and the reds, were teetering on the brink of extinction. Into this somewhat dodgy situation in popped Joel Battistututu, an ant completely convinced that he was the second incarnation of Christ. 

Joel decided to try his utmost to preserve the remaining ants by genetically manipulating them being completely identical - how could you destroy something that is identical to yourself after all? After some careful thinking, the ants decided to kill each others anyway.

Ant Wars II (or Ant Wars 1.9) is a hybrid between Artillery games like Scorched Earth and Worms. Your goal is to destroy the opposing ant colony using the weapons available that you can buy from the armory with the money you get from the field or buy winning the rounds.
Antago

Antago is a puzzle game played on a 5x5 square board. It can be played either against the computer, with a choice of up to 10 levels of difficulty, or against another human player. Other options allow you to play a match or start a training session, as well as select between "plain" (empty board) and "prepared" (pre-arranged balls on the board) game modes. A demo mode is also available, where the computer plays against itself.

An angel and a devil compete against each other, with the goal of aligning five "balls" in a row on the board, either horizontally, vertically or diagonally. They are moved around the board with the joystick, pushing each other as their paths cross, and strategically placing balls on the edge of the board to both disrupt their opponent's lines and try to create a line of 5 of their own balls.

Each level features different background and board graphics.
Antal
A Swedish educational game from SPAB, released in 1991.
Antares

Antares is a classic role-playing game of the Bard's Tale variety set in a science-fiction scenario. After the radio contact with space explorers stopped, a second troop goes to look for them. Unfortunately on the way they receive a emergency call, get shot and have to land on the planet Kyrion. Now the troop has to explore the planet and find out more about what happened.

The party has six members (chosen from twelve pre-defined characters) with different statistics and abilities, e.g. fighting, cooking, PSI (the science-fiction variant of magic) or translating (needed to communicate with non-hostile species). The world and dungeons are explored through a first-person perspective and when meeting enemies, the fight plays out turn-based: the player tells the characters what to do and text informs of the results. Killing enemies reward experience points which in turn improve the abilities.

Each character has to eat and sleep.
Antepenult

An Ultima-like game. This game contains at least four moderately-sized continents to explore. Game by Paul Falstad uses key presses instead of a parser. E.g. [ ; # and / to move around, A = attack etc.
Antheads: It Came From the Desert II Data Disk

Antheads: It Came from the Desert II is an add-on for It Came From the Desert. The story takes place five years after the original game. You are Brick Nash, who has stolen plutonium and prevented nuclear tests in the desert, so the people are mad at you because they didn't get any money but some are friendly like Biff and Dusty. The police are after you and people in Lizard Breath are turning into antheads. The gameplay remains unchanged from the base game.
Anti Matter

A freeware puzzle and logic game created by Adam Levin-Delson for a single player and released in 1995. The game functions as the original Black Box board game. It was published in several PD and shareware compilations, including Assassins G247 CD3. in this version you can set the amount of Atoms in the chamber and the size of the chamber for difficulty. The player must deduce the location of the hidden atoms by shooting rays into the box and seeing where it is reflected out of the chamber.
Anti PC

Anti PC is a relaxing sci-fi game to recover from a bad day. As an Amiga space fighter pilot, the player must shoot at hostile objects of PC origin. 

To eliminate the familiar-looking enemy, designated number of hits is required with a limited number of missiles. The space fighter may be moved left and right side, while the hostile object comes from the top of the screen.
Antispyrel

Antispyrel is an unreleased platformer that was done all the way up to the final level until the developer Stefan van de Horst of 1001 Software Developments abandoned the project. While a working version exists, there's no intro available and therefore no context on who you are or why you are there. 

Graphics tell you that you're a scientist inside a factory of some sort and you aim to move on by either jumping and cllimbing or by solving small puzzles.
Ants: The Masses Against the Massive

You are the antmaster. Your mission is to give doom or deliverance to hundreds of tiny dot-like creatures called The Ants. Direct armies of hundreds of tiny ants with your mouse cursor and guide them in destroying food, obstacles, bigger insects or make them march to their doom. 

Attacking the enemies will reduce your ants fast while eating food will increase their numbers rapidly to the maximum of 100. Leave the ants alone and they'll start wandering around, eventually ending up killing themselves by walking into various deadly traps.You need to balance between each game element to get the insect and move on to the next level.
Aonic, the Alien Hedgehog
Backbone demo game made by Vincent Perkins in 2 hours.
Apache

Apache is an Shoot 'Em Up game, developed and published by Team17, which was released in Europe in 1993. 
The game was released free with other Team 17 games.
Apache & Overdrive Demo

Released free with other Team 17 games, this full version of Apache and demo of Overdrive was first released in 1993. It was created by the team of David J. Broadhurst, Haydn Dalton and music by Allister Brimble (The Demon). 

Apache is a Choplifter/Fort Apocalypse type scrolling horizontal helicopter shooter, while Overdrive is a very good overhead racing game. 

Apache was never released separately.
Apache Flight

Apache Flight is a vertically scrolling shooter in which the player spends the most time shooting enemies by using the two available weapons: the unlimited standard ammo (released by tapping the fire button) and limited missiles (released by holding the fire button) which are required to hit ground targets, e.g. cannons and tanks. Those missiles are also available in the heat-seeking variety which are automatically used up first. Fuel is limited and is constantly drained every second, but it can be refilled by hovering over fuel depots which are regularly encountered during the levels. However, when shooting them with a missile instead, the depot releases additional missiles to collect. Of course it is also important to dodge enemies and their bullets because every hit causes the loss of a life. When that happens, a new helicopter with reset fuel and missiles appears with a brief invincibility period at the point of death. The game is lost when all lives are gone.
Apagon!
An Amiga homebrew game developed for Posadas 2025
Apano Sin

You find yourself in deep sleep on a long journey through space as part of a research mission. The onboard computer of your spaceship, "LEN," activates the wake-up mechanism of your life support unit due to an unexpectedly received high-priority distress signal.

The Fleet Admiralty reports a mutilated distress signal received from the ApanoSin planetary system. Since your spaceship is the only one on a direct course to ApanoSin, you are urged to interrupt your research mission to provide assistance to the base on ApanoSin.
